# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the live site, https://xernosz.github.io/DashCalc/, is supported. Fixes go out there.

DashCalc has no servers and no accounts. Everything runs in your browser, and your data stays on your device.

## Reporting a problem

Please report security problems privately: open this repository's **Security** tab and choose **Report a vulnerability** ([direct link](https://github.com/Xernosz/DashCalc/security/advisories/new)). Please don't post them as a public issue.

Include what you found, how to see it happen, and what could go wrong because of it.

## What to expect

DashCalc is a one-person hobby project, so there's no set response time. I'll look at every report as soon as I can.
